summary: Existing Demo Bank overdraft customers can apply for a credit limit increase directly within the mobile banking application. The requested limit is capped at a maximum of three times the customer's monthly salary and is subject to automated system checks. Upon approval, the upgraded limit takes effect immediately; otherwise, the customer retains their existing overdraft limit without alteration.

business_rules.rule: Only existing customers who already have an active overdraft facility at Demo Bank are eligible to request an overdraft limit increase via the mobile app.
business_rules.source_quote: Customers who already have an overdraft at Demo Bank should be able to request a higher limit from the mobile app.

business_rules.rule: The maximum permissible new overdraft limit must not exceed 3 times the customer's monthly salary.
business_rules.source_quote: The new limit can be up to 3 times the monthly salary.

business_rules.rule: Upon system approval of the limit increase request, the new overdraft limit must become active immediately in core banking and on the mobile app.
business_rules.source_quote: The system checks the request and, if approved, the new limit is active immediately.

business_rules.rule: If the limit increase request is not approved, the customer's existing overdraft limit remains unchanged.
business_rules.source_quote: If the request is not approved, the customer keeps the current limit.

open_questions.question: How is the monthly salary verified (e.g., automated average of incoming salary deposits over the last 3-6 months, open banking, or customer self-declaration with payslip upload)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without an objective salary verification source, Demo Bank cannot calculate the 3x limit cap reliably, exposing the bank to severe credit risk and miscalculation.

open_questions.question: What specific underwriting checks constitute 'the system checks the request' (e.g., internal debt-to-income, external credit bureau check, account conduct/arrears history)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Engineering cannot implement the approval engine without concrete decision rules, scorecard criteria, or external service integrations.

open_questions.question: Is explicit customer consent required before performing an external credit bureau check, and what regulatory disclosures (e.g., Consumer Credit Act/SECCI) must be presented and accepted before submitting?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Performing credit bureau hard searches or executing credit agreement modifications without explicit customer consent and statutory pre-contract disclosures breaches lending compliance.

open_questions.question: Is there an absolute minimum or maximum monetary cap on the overdraft limit regardless of monthly salary (e.g., minimum increase step of 100 EUR and hard limit cap of 10,000 EUR)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A high-earning customer could otherwise qualify for an excessively high unsecured overdraft exposure exceeding bank risk appetite.

open_questions.question: What detailed messaging, adverse action notice, or cooling-off period is shown to the customer when a request is declined?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Regulations often require fair lending notifications detailing reasons or credit reference agency contacts, while UX needs clear guidance on when the customer can reapply.

open_questions.question: What step-up authentication or identity verification (e.g., SCA, biometrics, OTP) is required before confirming the limit increase submission?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A compromised mobile session could allow unauthorized actors to elevate credit limits and drain funds fraudulently.

open_questions.question: How should system timeouts or downstream core banking failures during decisioning or limit activation be handled?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Technical glitches could result in inconsistent states where a limit is approved in the decision engine but unfulfilled in the core banking ledger.

risks.description: Increasing credit limits without mandatory pre-contractual credit information (SECCI/statutory disclosures) and explicit bureau check consent violates responsible lending regulations.
Lack of defined affordability assessments beyond simple salary multiples could lead to over-indebtedness and elevated default rates.
Account takeover fraudsters could exploit immediate limit activation on mobile devices to rapidly siphon increased credit line funds.
Failure to communicate decline reasons or re-application rules may cause heavy inbound call centre traffic and customer dissatisfaction.
Core banking latency or synchronization failure between the decision engine and ledger could cause display discrepancies or duplicate submissions.
Relying on outdated, inaccurate, or spoofed salary data records will lead to incorrect calculation of the maximum 3x borrowing limit.

stories.as_a: mobile banking customer with an existing overdraft
stories.i_want: to view my current limit and request a higher overdraft limit up to 3 times my monthly salary directly in the app
stories.so_that: I can access additional short-term credit conveniently without visiting a branch
stories.source_quote: Customers who already have an overdraft at Demo Bank should be able to request a higher limit from the mobile app. The new limit can be up to 3 times the monthly salary.

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer has an active overdraft on their Demo Bank checking account
acceptance_criteria.when: they navigate to the overdraft management section in the mobile app
acceptance_criteria.then: the app displays their current overdraft limit and provides an option to request an increase up to a maximum calculated as 3 times the verified monthly salary (as defined by Q-1 and subject to limits in Q-4).

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer does not have an existing overdraft facility
acceptance_criteria.when: they access the credit section in the mobile app
acceptance_criteria.then: the option to request an overdraft limit increase is not available or directs them to initial product onboarding.

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer enters a requested limit amount exceeding 3 times their monthly salary
acceptance_criteria.when: they attempt to proceed with the request
acceptance_criteria.then: the app blocks submission and displays an error indicating that the maximum permissible limit is 3 times monthly salary.

stories.as_a: mobile banking customer requesting a higher overdraft limit
stories.i_want: my request to be evaluated and, if approved, have the new limit activated immediately
stories.so_that: I can use the updated funds straight away
stories.source_quote: The system checks the request and, if approved, the new limit is active immediately.

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer submits a valid limit increase request within the 3x salary cap
acceptance_criteria.when: the system performs the automated checks (defined in Q-2) and the outcome is an approval
acceptance_criteria.then: the new overdraft limit is updated immediately in the core banking system and reflected in the customer mobile account balance.

acceptance_criteria.given: an approved limit request is finalized
acceptance_criteria.then: the customer receives an immediate in-app confirmation showing the new limit and the effective timestamp.

stories.as_a: mobile banking customer whose limit increase request is not approved
stories.i_want: my existing overdraft limit to remain fully intact and operational
stories.so_that: my current financial arrangements and available liquidity are not disrupted
stories.source_quote: If the request is not approved, the customer keeps the current limit.

acceptance_criteria.given: the customer submits an overdraft increase request
acceptance_criteria.when: the system checks evaluate the request and return a decline decision
acceptance_criteria.then: the customer's current overdraft limit remains unchanged with zero disruption to existing drawn or available funds.

acceptance_criteria.given: the request is declined by the system
acceptance_criteria.when: the decision is returned to the mobile app
acceptance_criteria.then: the app displays a decline notification (as defined in Q-5) confirming the existing limit remains unchanged.

uat_cases.title: Verify overdraft limit increase option is visible for eligible existing overdraft holders
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer has an active checking account with an existing overdraft limit of 1,000 EUR and verified monthly salary of 2,000 EUR.
steps: Log in to Demo Bank mobile app.
Navigate to Account Details > Manage Overdraft.
Observe displayed limit and available actions.
uat_cases.expected_result: Current limit of 1,000 EUR is displayed, 'Request Limit Increase' is enabled, and the maximum allowed limit is presented as 6,000 EUR (3x monthly salary).

uat_cases.title: Verify increase option is unavailable for customers without an overdraft
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer has an active checking account with no existing overdraft facility.
steps: Log in to Demo Bank mobile app.
Navigate to Account Details > Overdraft section.
uat_cases.expected_result: No option to 'Request Limit Increase' is present; customer is prompted to apply for a new overdraft or option is hidden.

uat_cases.title: Verify boundary condition for requested limit equal to exactly 3x monthly salary
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer monthly salary is verified at 2,500 EUR. Existing overdraft is 1,500 EUR.
steps: Log in to mobile app and start limit increase flow.
Enter requested limit of exactly 7,500 EUR (3 x 2,500 EUR).
uat_cases.expected_result: The input is accepted as valid without input validation error and request proceeds to credit checks.

uat_cases.title: Verify validation prevents requested limit exceeding 3x monthly salary
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer monthly salary is verified at 2,500 EUR. Existing overdraft is 1,500 EUR (3x limit is 7,500 EUR).
steps: Log in to mobile app and start limit increase flow.
Attempt to proceed to the next step.
uat_cases.expected_result: Form displays validation error stating the requested limit cannot exceed 7,500 EUR (3x monthly salary), and submission is blocked.

uat_cases.title: Verify immediate activation of approved limit increase
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer has current limit of 1,000 EUR, salary 3,000 EUR, credit profile configured to pass all automated checks.
steps: Log in and submit a limit increase request for 3,000 EUR.
Observe confirmation screen and return to account overview immediately.
uat_cases.expected_result: Approval confirmation screen appears with new limit of 3,000 EUR; account dashboard immediately reflects total available overdraft limit as 3,000 EUR.

uat_cases.title: Verify existing limit remains unchanged upon declined request
uat_cases.preconditions: Customer has current limit of 1,000 EUR, salary 2,000 EUR, credit profile configured to trigger decline in automated checks.
steps: Log in and submit a limit increase request for 4,000 EUR.
Review decline notification and check account balance screen.
uat_cases.expected_result: App presents a decline message stating the increase could not be granted; account overview confirms the overdraft limit remains at 1,000 EUR.
